commands: git fetch origin main && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "b9e165f13841c8b4dc0f65eae77c5dc3e0e460eb" && git status --short

printf '%s\n' '--- restart/service-console references ---'; git grep -n -E 'esp_restart|restart|reboot|ServiceConsole|service console' -- src components lib tools scripts Makefile docs ':!docs/HISTORY.md' ':!docs/CHANGELOG.md' || true

printf '%s\n' '--- serial/monitor/DTR/RTS references ---'; git grep -n -E 'idf.py monitor|esp_idf_monitor|DTR|RTS|hupcl|HUPCL|serial monitor|usbserial-1130' -- Makefile scripts tools docs config src components lib || true
printf '%s\n' '--- likely console source files ---'; find src components lib tools -type f \( -iname '*console*' -o -iname '*serial*' -o -iname '*diagnostic*' \) -maxdepth 8 -print | sort

printf '%s\n' '--- installed monitor help ---'; if command -v idf.py >/dev/null 2>&1; then idf.py monitor --help | sed -n '1,220p'; elif python3 -m esp_idf_monitor --help >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -m esp_idf_monitor --help | sed -n '1,220p'; else echo 'IDF_MONITOR_NOT_ON_DEFAULT_PATH'; fi

printf '%s\n' '--- pyserial/stty capabilities, no port open ---'; python3 - <<'PY'
import serial, inspect
print('pyserial', serial.VERSION)
print('Serial.open source:')
print(inspect.getsource(serial.Serial.open))
PY
printf '%s\n' '--- stty help ---'; stty --help 2>&1 | head -80 || true
